criteria.criterion: A completion verification whose primary run dies in a typed failure (budget exhaustion, runaway loop, or token exhaustion) with at least one criterion verdict banked ends in a full-coverage verdict instead of a verdict-less error — delivered by the banked-verification child; checked by its unit suite and a live Bedrock run recorded on that child.

No completion code path launches one isolated LLM run per criterion — delivered by the banked-verification child; checked by grep over src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py showing the fan-out removed, plus its unit suite.

The recovery preflight accepts the live c9f7 shape (121,147 chars x 22 criteria) under the two-ceiling bound with the d59e invariants intact — delivered by the context-ceilings child; checked by its held-out unit oracle and a live run recorded on that child.

Duplicate read-only tool calls inside one agentic run are served from a memo with a static nudge instead of re-executing, with the runaway actuator's window math unchanged — delivered by the duplicate-call damping child; checked by its unit tests and a live Bedrock capture recorded on that child.

The completion verifier's context pre-loads ranked file_impact contents with a full/skeleton manifest and reduces live request counts by at least 20% with verdict class unchanged versus the post-rework baseline — delivered by the pre-loading child; checked per that child's live A/B acceptance criteria.
